title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand, 49-Inch Solid Brass Bathroom Stand, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Oil Rubbed Bronze, freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand for bathroom towel storage and drying, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This freestanding towel stand / towel rack / towel holder uses four pivoting swing arms to separate towels and maximize space with no wall mounting. Size: 49 inches tall (49-inch, 49 in) with a 12 inches x 9.25 inches base footprint (12-inch x 9.25-inch; 12 in x 9.25 in). Solid brass construction with a heavy weighted base to help prevent tipping, plus a felt pad to prevent scratching on surfaces. Modern, clean-lined transitional look as part of the Soho collection, ideal for matching Soho and other versatile bath accessories. Weight capacity: 20 lb. Some assembly required. Includes towel stand. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass, Soho collection.
